comparison.objective: Press a PCIe slot latch and remove a graphics card to a tray; candidate releases and removes one crimp terminal from a connector housing.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold one accessible external latch and lift a large card straight out versus guide two blades around a recessed contact, depress both tangs, optionally push the wire forward, and pull from the opposite side.
comparison.success_condition: Requires latch-first card removal and stable tray placement without slot prying; candidate requires only the selected terminal exit, neighbors retained, crimp intact, housing reusable, and a three-second released state. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Both are latch-before-pull removals, but the candidate adds meaningfully different contact-scale tool alignment, bilateral tang release, and selective neighbor protection.
